mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS < 0.1%, the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 9.0) signals weak labor market conditions that dampen consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when UNRATE > 9.0, the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 12-month moving averages signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 12mo_MA and RSAFS > 12mo_MA, the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a low interest rate environment (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%), a high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 9.0) signals weak labor market conditions that dampen economic growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS < 0.1%, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) signals stronger economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between INDPRO and 5-day S&P 500 returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 650 thousand units, it signals a strengthening residential sector that boosts consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when HOUST > 650, the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong job growth (PAYEMS > 100) and declining unemployment (UNRATE < 9.0) signals a tightening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS > 100 and UNRATE < 9.0, the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation environment (CPIAUCSL > 225), a decline in retail sales (RSAFS < 380000) signals weakening consumer demand that may trigger a recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL > 225, the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS < 380000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
